Fran (CSM): Quick 12m kickoff to align on Mariner onboarding. Goals: owners, 30d acceptance, 3 renewal signals. Proposed Fri 08:45 PT.
Eli (Mariner PO): 08:45 PT works. Legal will join for a 5m retention/masking check. Can we get a lightweight cost estimate after you see our sample payloads?
Noor (Solutions Eng): For integration we need a sanitized sample JSON and expected burst qps. If burst >35qps we'll discuss reserved capacity.
Eli (Mariner PO): Sending sanitized schema + 50 rows by EOD Thurs.
Raj (Enablement): I'll run a 20-min follow-up: 10-min demo + 10-min runbook. Will record and include masking verification steps and an audit-log checklist.
Fran (CSM): Draft 30d acceptance to confirm in sync:
- Staging ingest + two core flows validated end-to-end
- Recorded demo + runbook delivered
- Dashboard with 3 signals: flow usage, ingest error rate, time-to-first-successful-inference
Risks: data-signoff delay, quota surprises, retention signoff lag. We'll tag owners in the call.
Noor (Solutions Eng): Staging smoke curl I'll run once keys are live: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "Mariner onboarding intake (12m)" Fri 08:45 PT. Invitees: Fran, Eli, Noor, Raj, Legal.
Fran (CSM): I'll drop a 1-pager with pre-reqs 2 hours before and open a follow-up 30/60 milestone doc. See you Friday :white_check_mark:
